clips.title: The story
paras: In Thunder Bluff, Tal the Wind Rider Master awaits a parcel from Ahanu. It is bound for Jahan Hawkwing at the Crossroads, linking Mulgore’s leatherworkers with Barrens merchants.

Ahanu, a leatherworker on Thunder Bluff’s lower rise, sends finished hides to Jahan Hawkwing’s trade stall at the Crossroads. Trade between Mulgore and the Barrens matters to the young Horde, but the journey down the bluffs and across the plains takes hours on foot. Winged couriers carry parcels over the divide.

On Thunder Bluff’s highest central tier, Tal tends the city’s wind riders, also called wyverns. The winged beasts cross Kalimdor’s rugged peaks and shifting thermal drafts. Tal arranges flights to outposts such as the Crossroads, carrying messengers and cargo between the tauren capital and its orcish allies.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I have prepared leather goods for Jahan to sell at the Crossroads. Will you bring them to him?
If you have already been to the Crossroads and spoken to their wind rider master, then you can fly one of our Thunder Bluff wind riders back to him.
Take the leather goods to Tal, our wind rider master in Thunder Bluff, and speak with him to arrange transport to the Crossroads.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, adventurer. What can I do for you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You need to take this to the Crossroads, eh? That's not a problem. If you've already been there and spoken to Devrak, then you can take one of my wind riders back to him.
